adjudicated.rationale: Legitimate cross-lens divergence (prestige-without-belonging precedent): the Queen of Naples deliberately treats her as the evening's center (witnessed standing rise) while her own guests bypass her as hostess and address only Charlus (belonging loss). Both movements are explicit in the passage.

Legitimate cross-lens divergence: guests queue to flatter Charlus as though he were host (witnessed standing rise) in the same scene where Mme Verdurin fabricates the case that will expel him from the clan (belonging loss). The novel stages the divergence deliberately.
